facts.raw_span: A 56-year-old woman
no significant medical history
4-week history of dry cough
mild weight loss
denied fever
coarse crepitations were heard over the right upper and lower lung zones
chest radiograph showed an air-space opacity in the right upper lobe
CT of the thorax demonstrated multifocal consolidations in the right upper lobe extending to the right lower lobe
Mantoux tuberculin skin test showed 10 mm of induration
sputum induction for acid-fast bacilli was negative
bronchoalveolar lavage was negative for Xpert Mycobacterium tuberculosis/rifampicin assay
Two courses of antibiotics produced no improvement
